'''Chadra-Fan''' was the official language of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chad/Legends|Chad]], spoken mainly by the native [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

Chadra-Fan language sounded quite different from [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]. This was noticed because Chadra-Fans who learned to speak Basic sounded very nasal and squeaky.

Individual words and thoughts were not separated by pauses and silences as they were in Basic, which meant that Chandra-Fan speaking the language strung words and sentences together particularly rapidly.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
